2607.26724.title: UrbanDS: A Graph-Guided LLM Multi-Agent System for Data-Intensive Urban Tasks
2607.26724.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have been widely applied in automating data science tasks. However, existing methods typically rely on a limited set of provided datasets, and they face challenges in data-intensive scenarios that require discovering and leveraging relevant information from large-scale and heterogeneous data repositories. Urban tasks are representative examples of such scenarios, as urban data are not only large-scale and multi-sourced, but also exhibit complex spatial, temporal, and semantic relationships. To address these challenges, we propose UrbanDS, a graph-guided LLM multi-agent system for data-intensive urban tasks. We first construct a unified dataset graph to organize reusable dataset skills and the relationships among datasets. Specifically, we develop a Data Profiling Agent that constructs a skill for each dataset. Moreover, a Relation Agent identifies relationships among datasets and integrates these relationships into the dataset graph. At runtime, a Planner Agent retrieves task-relevant datasets from the graph and generates execution plans. Multiple Execution Agents then perform data processing and analysis, while their execution progress and intermediate results are shared through a common memory. Finally, a Report Agent synthesizes the experimental logs into a report, which can be further refined based on user feedback. To systematically evaluate the capability of agents in handling data-intensive urban scenarios, we further construct UrbanDS-Bench, an urban data science benchmark covering representative data analysis and modeling tasks. Experiments on both general and urban benchmarks demonstrate that UrbanDS consistently outperforms existing data science agents on data-intensive tasks. Furthermore, UrbanDS has been deployed on the urban operations platform of Dongxihu District, Wuhan, demonstrating its effectiveness in real-world urban applications.
2607.26724.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理已廣泛應用於自動化數據科學任務。<lb/>然而，現有方法通常依賴於有限的一組提供數據集，並且在需要從大規模和異質數據庫中發現和利用相關信息的數據密集場景中面臨挑戰。<lb/>城市任務是這類場景的典型例子，因為城市數據不僅規模龐大且來源多樣，還表現出複雜的空間、時間和語義關係。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了UrbanDS，一個針對數據密集型城市任務的圖引導LLM多代理系統。<lb/>我們首先構建一個統一的數據集圖，以組織可重用的數據集技能及其之間的關係。<lb/>具體而言，我們開發了一個數據概況代理，為每個數據集構建一個技能。<lb/>此外，一個關係代理識別數據集之間的關係並將這些關係整合到數據集圖中。<lb/>在運行時，計劃代理從圖中檢索與任務相關的數據集並生成執行計劃。<lb/>多個執行代理隨後執行數據處理和分析，同時通過公共記憶共享其執行進度和中間結果。<lb/>最後，一個報告代理將實驗日誌綜合成報告，該報告可以根據用戶反饋進一步完善。<lb/>為了系統地評估代理在處理數據密集型城市場景中的能力，我們進一步構建了UrbanDS-Bench，一個涵蓋代表性數據分析和建模任務的城市數據科學基準。<lb/>在一般和城市基準上的實驗表明，UrbanDS在數據密集型任務上始終優於現有的數據科學代理。<lb/>此外，UrbanDS已在武漢東西湖區的城市運營平台上部署，展示了其在現實城市應用中的有效性。
